title: Alice in Wonderland
ending: Chapter 1 complete. Alice is safely afloat, with another swimmer nearby.
description: From the riverbank to the Pool of Tears.
stageLabel: Alice and her sister beside the river

steps.text: Her sister was in no hurry. Alice rather wished the afternoon were.
A book with not even a picture?
There are many good books in this world without pictures.
Oh dear! I shall be late! I'm late!
What could a rabbit be late for?
Wait, please!
Just a little farther.
I only wanted to ask you something.
Oh!
For a moment, Alice forgot every question she had meant to ask.
A jar?
Not a spoonful left.
You had better stay here.
Well. I seem to be all here.
Late! Still late!
One thing at a time.
So many doors. Surely one must open.
A little golden key! Which door could it open?
That is where I want to be, but I am far too big to get through.

steps.text: A bottle? ‘Drink me.’ That is a very confident bottle.
No poison marked. That is something.
Just a little.
Oh! I am smaller. How strange everything looks from here.
Now I could fit through that little door.
But the key! I left it on the table.
Perhaps I can climb up.
Too smooth. I cannot get a foothold.
A little box under the table. What is inside?

steps.text: "Eat me." You are just as sure of yourself.
Bigger, I can reach the key. Smaller, I might slip under the door.
Nothing yet.
That will do. Please.
At last, the key.
And now I am much too big for the door.
I only wanted to reach the garden.
These tears are making quite a mess.
Come now, Alice. One thing at a time.

steps.text: Please, could you help me?
The Duchess! I shall be late!
Perhaps a little air will help.
I am getting smaller again.
The fan! I must let go.
Still here. That was close.
My own tears. What a very large mistake.
I can swim. Slowly, now.
A mouse! At least I am not alone.
